leadText:
For the opening used on Toonami Jetstream, see Pokémon Chronicles theme.
 
Pokémon Chronicles is the opening theme song for the dub of Pokémon Chronicles.

The opening animation featured footage from the English opening, Pokérap GS, and clips from various Chronicles episodes.

==Lyrics==
===TV version===
 
! Italian
! English

I wanna be in the Pokémon world!
I wanna be with the Pokémons,
in the Pokémon Chronicles, Pokémon Chronicles!

Scegli un Pokémon,
poi catturalo e addestralo perché...
...se ti impegnerai, se lo spronerai,
giocherà con te!

Per difenderti, per proteggerti,
tutto rischierà!
Con lui vincerai, ma se perderai,
non ti tradirà!

Siamo arrivati dentro al cuore della storia oramai!
Non c'è più tempo per chi esita, perciò prendi e vai!
(Pokémon!) Per ogni Sfera un nuovo amico tu avrai!
(Chronicles!) Con il tuo Pokémon battaglia darai!

I wanna be with the Pokémons,
in the Pokémon Chronicles, Pokémon Chronicles!
Catch 'em all! 

I wanna be in the Pokémon world!
I wanna be with the Pokémon,
in the Pokémon Chronicles, Pokémon Chronicles!

Choose a Pokémon,
and then catch and train him because...
...if you are committed, if you motivate him,
he will play with you!

To defend you, to protect you,
he will risk everything!
With him, you will win, but if you lose,
he won't betray you!

We have arrived at the heart of the story now!
There is no more time for hesitation, so go!
(Pokémon!) For every Ball, you will have a new friend!
(Chronicles!) With your Pokémon, you will battle!

I wanna be with the Pokémon,
in the Pokémon Chronicles, Pokémon Chronicles!
Catch 'em all!

==Video==
 

==Trivia==
The plural of Pokémon is sung as "Pokémons", despite being normally constructed in Italian as "Pokémon".
There is no neuter word for 'it' in Italian as all words in Italian have grammatical gender. For this reason, all Pokémon in this song are referred to as male.
